english_title: Proposition 3: Generalization of Proposition 1 to LCA Groups
statement_en: Let $G$ be an LCA group and let $f \in L^1(G)$. For any $a\in G$, define $T_a(f):=f(a^{-1}x)$. Then for every $\varepsilon >0$ there exists a neighborhood $U_{\varepsilon}$ of the identity element $1_G$ such that for all $h \in U_{\varepsilon}$, $$\|T_{ah}(f)-T_a(f)\|_{L^1(G)}<\varepsilon.$$
